an8.20:1.1: 20 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
an8.20:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an8.20:1.3: athakho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:1.4: abhikkantā bhante ratti nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho
an8.20:2.2: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:2.3: abhikkantā bhante ratti nikkhanto majjhimo yāmo ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho
an8.20:2.6: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhaste aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:2.7: abhikkantā bhante ratti nikkhanto pacchimo yāmo uddhastaṃ aruṇaṃ nandimukhī ratti
an8.20:3.2: kiṃ nu kho bhagavā puggalaṃ sandhāya evamāha
an8.20:3.4: athakho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sabbāvantaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasākāsi
an8.20:3.5: addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asucisaṃkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakammantaṃ assamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacārīpaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambukajātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ
an8.20:3.6: disvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena so puggalo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ puggalaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:4.1: evaṃ vutte so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi
an8.20:4.2: dutiyampi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:4.5: dutiyampi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi
an8.20:4.6: tatiyampi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:4.9: tatiyampi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi
an8.20:5.1: athakho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.20:5.6: yāvatā bāhāgahaṇāpi nāma so moghapuriso āgamissatīti
an8.20:6.2: tumhevadāni bhikkhave uposathaṃ kareyyātha pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyyātha
an8.20:6.3: na dānāhaṃ bhikkhave ajjatagge pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi
an8.20:6.4: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
an8.20:7.1: aṭṭhime bhikkhave mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti
an8.20:7.3: mahāsamuddo bhikkhave anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.20:7.4: yampi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.20:7.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. yathā purimena tathā vitthāro
an8.20:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā …pe… pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.20:8.2: yampi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā …pe… pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.20:8.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.20:8.4: ime kho bhikkhave mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.20:9.1: aṭṭhime bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti
an8.20:9.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.20:9.4: evameva kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā nāyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho
an8.20:9.5: yampi bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā nāyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho
an8.20:9.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti …pe…
an8.20:9.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā …pe… pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.20:9.8: evameva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno …pe… arahā arahattāya paṭipanno
an8.20:9.9: yampi bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno …pe… arahā arahattāya paṭipanno
an8.20:9.10: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.20:9.11: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
